title: Deleting a disconnected controller deletes all disconnected controllers
description: When attempting to delete a single disconnected controller from the controller list, all other disconnected controllers are also deleted.
steps: Launch the application with no controllers connected and an empty controller list.
Connect controllers and add them manually.
Disconnect the controllers that were recently added.
Navigate to the Controller List and refresh the list to display the disconnected controllers.
Select one of the disconnected controllers.
Confirm deletion by tapping 'DELETE' on the confirmation dialog.
actual: All disconnected controllers are deleted from the list after deleting one.
expected: Only the selected disconnected controller should be deleted from the list.
